title: Bounded symmetric scalar Gaussian channels have an exact tenth-order relative-Fisher expansion

hermite_law.scope: X is one bounded symmetric centered unit-variance real seed.
hermite_law.moments: kappa_4=E H_4(X), kappa_6=E H_6(X), h_8=E H_8(X), h_10=E H_10(X).
hermite_law.derivation: Expand integral phi (r_t')^2/r_t with the Mehler density ratio and evaluate every Gaussian Hermite contraction exactly.

scope_guard: The expansion is a fixed bounded symmetric seed theorem near t=0. It is not uniform for growing support, vanishing defect, singular chart boundaries or finite channel strength.
